# PNY GEFORCE RTX™ 5060 8GB ARGB Overclocked Triple Fan DLSS 4 Brochure

Author: PNY Technologies

Fifth-Gen Tensor Cores Max AI performance with FP4 and DLSS 4

#### Fourth-Gen Ray Tracing Cores Built for Mega Geometry

## PNY GEFORCE RTX™ 5060 8GB

##### ARGB Overclocked Triple Fan DLSS 4

VCG50608TFXXPB1-O

### GAME CHANGER

Get game-changing performance with the GeForce RTX™ 5060, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell. Game at high frame rates with DLSS 4, supercharge your creativity with NVIDIA Studio, and enable new experiences with the power of AI.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

• PCI Express Gen 5-compliant motherboard with one 2-width x8 graphics slot 
• One 8-pin supplementary power connector 
• 550 W or greater system power supply 2 

KEY FEATURES

• NVIDIA DLSS 4 
• NVIDIA Reflex 2 
• GDDR7 Graphics Memory 
• NVIDIA ® App 
• PCI Express ® Gen 5 
• NVIDIA Broadcast 

TRIPLE FAN COOLING

With three fans working together, heat is distributed and dissipated more efficiently across the GPU surface

• Microsoft Windows® 11 64-bit, Linux 64-bit 
• Internet connection 1 

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS NVIDIA ® CUDA Cores 3840

METAL BACKPLATE

Adds additional support to prevent the card from sagging and vents that enhance passive cooling
